steps.en: Install the client and authenticate once
steps.code: uv pip install modal · modal setup

steps.en: Describe the workload as Python: image, resources, secrets
steps.zh: 用 Python 描述负载：镜像、资源、密钥

steps.en: Run or deploy that file from your machine
steps.zh: 在本机运行或部署这个文件

steps.en: Builds the container, schedules it in the cloud and streams results back
steps.zh: 构建容器、在云里调度执行并把结果流回来

steps.en: Scales with traffic and back down, with no cluster for you to run
steps.zh: 随流量扩缩，你这边没有集群要运维

steps.en: Creates Sandboxes on request for AI-generated code
steps.zh: 按需创建 Sandbox 执行 AI 生成的代码

value.en: Serverless containers, GPUs and sandboxes you never operate — you write Python and accept a closed, hosted platform
value.zh: serverless 容器、GPU 与沙箱都不用你运维——只写 Python，也接受一个闭源托管平台

sources: https://github.com/modal-labs/modal-client (uv pip install modal; JS/Go SDKs use Sandboxes and invoke Functions; modal skills install)
https://modal.com/docs/guide (pip install modal; modal setup; modal run path/to/file.py; Sandboxes; everything is code; we host everything)
